title: Markets, tapas, and bicycles: an incredible experience
text:
The tour was a fantastic experience. 
Exploring Barcelona by bike while discovering local markets and tasting typical tapas was a very authentic and fun way to get to know the city.
The guide Simon was very kind, attentive, and knew a lot of interesting facts about Barcelona and its gastronomy. The stops at the markets were very well chosen, and the tapas were delicious.
I totally recommend this experience to anyone who wants to discover Barcelona in a different and tasty way!!
author: DeboraDellomonaco

title: The best experience we had in Barcelona
text:
The sea! and the markets, I love riding a bicycle :)
My favorite was the eggplant tapas, honey, and goat cheese.
author: laurale296

title: Without a doubt, the best part of my trip to Barcelona
text: I loved getting to know the city by bike. Simón took us to see the sea and we visited three markets in Barcelona. Trying foods and biking occasionally was the perfect balance!!
author: osmauger26
